row.title: REPO-CONFORM-2 stage 1 of 3: one identity renderer and a deploy button that builds from the kit root
row.body: Decision: the kit renders every identity file from ultrastable.json with one implementation, seed/scripts/surfaces.py (README blocks, CITATION.cff, publiccode.yml, catalog-info.yaml, llms.txt, REUSE.toml, codemeta.json, LICENSES/<id>.txt; CHANGELOG, CONTRIBUTING and SECURITY only when missing), and a copy of the template takes its own identity in the boot's adopt stage (IDENTITY-AT-BIRTH-1), so the fleet map and the kernel sync leave those files to the system. Decision: the kit root carries wrangler.jsonc and package.json with no placeholder, so the Deploy to Cloudflare button builds a fresh copy, wrangler deploy creates the D1 database, and the tick applies its own migrations before its first heartbeat row (DEPLOY-BUTTON-1, MIGRATE-FIRST-1). The whole change exceeds the SMALL-CHANGE-1 limit (seed/autonomy/prsize.json), so it lands as three sequential pull requests, each green alone; this is the first. Evidence: seed/tests/test_surfaces.py, seed/tests/test_happy_path.py (test_2b, test_2c), seed/worker/test/deploy-config.test.js, tests/foundation/test_spec_31_fleet.py and tests/foundation/test_open_standards.py pass, python3 scripts/surfaces.py --check reads the kit as equal to its render, and python3 -m foundation checksrun ran every step the session can run.
